page.overview:
What is Liberation of Coruscant?

The Liberation of Coruscant was a battle during the Jedi-Sith War, in which the Jedi Order succeeded in driving the Sith off Coruscant. Later, an arcade of stained-glass windows and statues in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant honored the Jedi heroes of this battle.
